checks.name: Initial browser projection retains source order and filters repeated plain links
Projected browser rows retain explicit unchecked semantics
URL names and normalized extensions are prepared before the GUI consumes rows
Scoped observed size metadata avoids an unnecessary preview request
The initial category destination is projected from the same settings snapshot
A later URL edit invalidates cached naming and destination evidence
Projecting and editing a result never mutates immutable caller inputs
Ordinary imports keep repeated rows and untouched default checks
Import request and name preparation preserves each original address
The initial browser image filter applies only to matched source context
Mismatched browser context supplies no observed hints, headers, image flag or website session
Media rows retain their names and unknown track-size state and are not deduplicated as ordinary URLs
Prepared preview requests own the complete matching headers, route and session
A saved login prevents reusing observed metadata for a potentially different authenticated request
Changing browser proxy policy invalidates the observed hint fast path
Projection cancellation is checked between rows without partially publishing the result
Projection rejects a browser-context cardinality mismatch
The owned initial worker projects rows only after releasing the catalog lock
Row preparation and metadata owner creation never mutate catalog state or accepted ownership
